packageRules.description: Major updates are paused for this repo. TypeScript 7 is rejected by typescript-eslint (peer '>=4.8.4 <6.1.0', reached transitively via eslint-config-next), and ESLint 10 breaks eslint-plugin-react, which still calls the removed context.getFilename(). Every narrower hold tried before this one just surfaced the next blocked major in the same grouped PR, so the monthly major stream was pure noise: it could not go green and it held nothing useful. Security updates are unaffected -- vulnerabilityAlerts runs on its own schedule and ignores packageRules. Minor and patch updates continue normally. Delete this rule once typescript-eslint accepts TS 7 and eslint-plugin-react supports ESLint 10.
